headline: Released numbers broadly reproduced; stronger claims remain unconfirmed
conclusion: We broadly reproduced the released numerical table, but did not confirm the paper's stronger claims of universal stable convergence or a robust capacity-headroom rule; actual output-quality improvement remains unresolved.

claim_assessments.basis: Twelve of fifteen published Track R deltas fell inside conditional prompt intervals, with three misses and substantial directional uncertainty.
The prescribed PPO budget was reached in eleven of fifteen Track R arms and twelve of fifteen Track M arms.
The explicit PPL necessary condition held in Track R but failed in Track M, while reward-signal informativeness was not operationalized for the full joint claim.
Internal reward scores are not independently calibrated across tracks, and the Qwen reviewer did not pass its outer-teacher reliability audit.

extension_call_to_action.prompt: Which follow-up would most improve confidence in this result?

options.label: Measure run-to-run variance
options.summary: Repeat the three Track R misses, one positive anchor, and one rollback-prone arm across fresh training seeds and repeated decoding draws.

options.label: Repeat compatibility arms
options.summary: Retrain the eight compatibility-trained arms under the exact reconstructed paper-era software stack on compatible accelerators.

options.label: Isolate Track M changes
options.summary: Use a preregistered factorial to separate reward initialization, reward-inference dtype, and rollback optimizer-state reset.

options.label: Audit actual output quality
options.summary: Run counterbalanced blinded judging with a human-audited calibration subset and an outer teacher that audits reviewer reliability.

options.label: Run a clean-room reproduction
options.summary: Ask an independent operator to reproduce the result using only the tagged public materials and record every ambiguity.

evidence_navigation.goal: Every matrix result should open a stable, human-readable path into the evidence supporting that arm-level outcome.

semantic_definitions.configuration: One model, dataset, and seed combination shared across method tracks.
semantic_definitions.arm: The selected scientific claim unit for one configuration and track.
semantic_definitions.attempt: One immutable execution, including failed attempts and recovery lineage; attempts are not independent scientific replicates when they reuse prerequisites.
semantic_definitions.outcome: The claim-level result selected under the frozen protocol.
semantic_definitions.artifact: A hash-bound report, record, log, generation set, manifest, or checkpoint supporting an outcome.

matrix_interaction.accessibility_requirement: Provide a keyboard-focusable named link in every row; do not rely on row click, hover, glyph, or color alone.

comparison_rules: Render published_delta_inside_release_interval and the directional assessment as separate judgments.
Do not present MATCH as full numerical reproduction when the published estimate falls outside the rerun interval.
Label every displayed interval as conditional on the retained checkpoint and generations.
Display the Holm-adjusted paired p-value with the independent paired endpoint, not as support for the sampled release endpoint.
Keep the study-level PARTIALLY_REPRODUCED classification visually distinct from the arm-level directional verdict.

phase_two_evidence_index.purpose: Expose sanitized attempt timelines and direct per-arm artifact links without leaking private infrastructure.
phase_two_evidence_index.frontend_behavior_until_available: Show the selected arm evidence and study-level artifacts, label attempt-level and raw-output drilldown as unavailable, and never synthesize missing URLs or attempt histories.

privacy_requirements: Use neutral public host aliases only.
Do not expose local paths, usernames, raw hostnames, service identifiers, addresses, credentials, or GPU UUIDs.
Link large evidence only at immutable public revisions with a digest.
Preserve failed and superseded attempts once the sanitized attempt index is published.
